scope: Administrative receipt/archival verification only; no new product tests or independent G2

first_reader.reason: One git subprocess per old file was unnecessarily slow; only this owned administrative process was stopped. Original command/stdout/stderr retained; not recast as passed.

replacement.method: Read one immutable fixed Git archive, retaining byte comparisons for every old file, current identity, exact incoming files and permissions.

current_snapshot_count_note: The retained pre-commit snapshot counted365 new archive files before these extra administrative logs were added; final Git diff count is recorded externally/PR after commit. No self-referential final manifest.
